meta.breadth: unavailable (no point-in-time history in repo); breadth factor = 0 for all models
meta.southbound: not used by any model; research/data/ not present at run time

baselines.rw_gauss: random walk, Gaussian: sigma = sd of last 60 log returns before t, P(zone of close_t | c_{t-1}) analytic (FPP P0-1), production boundedRound [0.10,0.85]/0.05
baselines.rw_emp: random walk, empirical: last <=250 returns before t rescaled to sigma60, production rounding
baselines.persistence: PRIMARY: expanding empirical transition P(o_t|o_{t-1}) with +1 smoothing, pairs realised < t

meta.v3_raw_note: rule-weights-v3_raw = unbounded/unrounded v3 softmax (same frozen W); scoring-only comparison, production keeps [0.10,0.85] step 0.05 (SF-P0-2 needs walk-forward before any change). v3 W was fitted on 2024-10-02..2025-12-15, so that span is in-sample for v3.
meta.note: 只评估、未调参。Brier 为三类求和形式（0–2，均匀 1/3 基准 = 0.667）。CI 为 10 日移动块 bootstrap 2000 次。BSS = 1 − BS_model/BS_ref。Murphy: BS = REL − RES + UNC（按 0.05 档分组）。
